# Observability Checklist: SPEC-014C First Real Harness Adapter Pilot

**Purpose**: Validate observability requirement quality for AgentRun summaries, task-stage attempt links, lifecycle evidence, activity entries, usage/failure diagnostics, safe artifact descriptors, traceability, and HAL UAT evidence.
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are AgentRun status and outcome summary requirements defined for blocked, launched, completed, failed, timed-out, abandoned, and cleanup-failed states? [Completeness, Spec FR-012; Spec FR-022; Schema: codex_app_server_run.v1]
- [x] CHK002 Are task-stage attempt links to run, claim, manifest, and lifecycle evidence defined so successful attempts end as `succeeded` and failure/timeout attempts remain distinguishable? [Completeness, Spec FR-012; Spec FR-021; Data Model: Claimed Stage Attempt]
- [x] CHK003 Are sandbox lifecycle evidence requirements defined for prepare, running, terminal, cleanup-pending, cleaned-up, and cleanup-failed phases? [Completeness, Spec FR-006; Spec FR-009; Data Model: Paddock-Owned Sandbox Lifecycle]
- [x] CHK004 Are activity-entry requirements defined with enough fields to link run, attempt, claim, lifecycle, artifact, phase/reason, and safe operator summary evidence? [Resolved, Spec FR-012; Data Model: Activity Entry; Contract: Operator-Visible Evidence]
- [x] CHK005 Are usage summary requirements complete for available, partial, and unavailable usage without inferred token metrics? [Completeness, Spec FR-013; Data Model: Adapter Run Evidence; Schema: codex_app_server_run.v1]
- [x] CHK006 Are failure summary requirements complete for reason code, phase, diagnostic category, related ids, counts, rejected field paths, safe hash/size, and safe error label? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications: Evidence, Artifacts, And Redaction; Data Model: Failure Summary]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Are operator-visible phase diagnostics specified with a closed phase vocabulary that covers eligibility, lifecycle preparation, spawn, initialize, thread start, turn start, running, terminal, artifact safety, cleanup, subprocess termination, and lifecycle cleanup? [Clarity, Schema: codex_app_server_run.v1]
- [x] CHK008 Are reason-code diagnostics specific enough to avoid generic failed/ineligible labels for admission blocks and adapter failures? [Clarity, Spec FR-016-FR-019; Contract: Dispatch And Evidence Integration]
- [x] CHK009 Is cleanup-failed observability clarified so subprocess termination failure and lifecycle cleanup failure do not replace the original terminal outcome or reason? [Clarity, Plan: Terminal Mapping; Data Model: Failure Summary]
- [x] CHK010 Are unavailable-binary, malformed-protocol, unsafe-evidence, and unsupported-request diagnostics required to be operator-visible without raw protocol excerpts? [Clarity, Spec FR-019; Data Model: Failure Summary]
- [x] CHK011 Are bounded protocol correlation identifiers limited to opaque thread, session, and turn ids rather than raw protocol payloads? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications: Codex App-Server Protocol; Data Model: Codex App-Server Protocol Session]
- [x] CHK012 Does the run-evidence schema make prompt-body or raw-prompt retention measurably false alongside transcript, protocol, provider, tool, host-path, and secret retention flags? [Resolved, Spec SC-005; Schema: codex_app_server_run.v1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can success criteria objectively measure that 100% of eligible UAT attempts produce run, attempt, lifecycle, activity, and safe evidence summaries visible to an operator? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK019 Can operator distinguishability be objectively measured for all listed outcomes without reading raw transcripts? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-006]
- [x] CHK020 Can safe-evidence acceptance be measured as zero raw transcript, provider payload, tool payload, prompt body, secret, or unsafe host-path publication? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-005; Data Model: Adapter Run Evidence]
- [x] CHK021 Can HAL UAT evidence quality be measured through one real handshake/thread/turn launch, deterministic failure fixture evidence, lifecycle cleanup, and zero disposable-row plus sandbox/artifact residue? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-007; Data Model: HAL UAT Fixture]
- [x] CHK022 Are PR review packet traceability requirements measurable for mapping every P1-P3 story and failure category to evidence? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-008; Spec PR Review Packet Requirements]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are primary launch, blocked-before-launch, successful completion, timeout, binary unavailable, malformed protocol, unsupported request, unsafe evidence, abandoned ownership, and cleanup-failed observability scenarios all covered? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases; Contract: Operator-Visible Evidence]
- [x] CHK024 Are partial usage, missing usage, safe output with no artifact, unsafe output, artifact rejection, cleanup failure, and stale ownership edge cases represented in observable evidence requirements? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases; Data Model: Failure Summary]
- [x] CHK025 Are deterministic HAL failure fixtures required to exercise the same parser, failure mapper, timeout, lifecycle, and artifact/redaction paths as live protocol events? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications: UAT And Deployment; Data Model: HAL UAT Fixture]
- [x] CHK026 Are feature-flag-off and ineligible-admission diagnostics represented as blocked evidence without task terminal or GitHub mutation? [Coverage, Spec FR-005; Spec FR-020; Contract: Dispatch Admission]

## Evidence Safety

- [x] CHK027 Are safe artifact descriptor requirements limited to artifact id/ref, type/kind, schema version, MIME/media type, byte size/count, digest, redaction/security status, timestamp, and optional bounded safe summary or label? [Safety, Spec Clarifications: Evidence, Artifacts, And Redaction; Data Model: Safe Artifact Reference]
- [x] CHK028 Are forbidden observability payloads explicitly excluded, including storage URI, raw content, preview text, original filename, paths, external URLs, provider/tool/MCP payloads, transcripts, prompt bodies, command/file-change details, raw reasoning, and secrets? [Safety, Data Model: Adapter Run Evidence; Contract: Output And Artifact Contract]
- [x] CHK029 Are activity and failure diagnostics required to use safe labels, counts, categories, ids, field paths, hashes, and sizes instead of raw payload excerpts? [Safety, Data Model: Failure Summary; Contract: Operator-Visible Evidence]
- [x] CHK030 Are checked-in HAL UAT artifacts limited to descriptor-level and redacted evidence while live rows, sandbox directories, and artifact files are cleaned unless an explicit exception is recorded? [Safety, Spec Evidence And Archive Policy; Data Model: HAL UAT Fixture]

## Notes

- Focus areas selected: AgentRun summaries, task-stage attempt/run links, lifecycle evidence, activity entries, bounded usage and failure summaries, operator-visible reason/phase diagnostics, safe artifact descriptors, cross-surface traceability, raw-payload exclusion, and HAL UAT evidence.
- Depth level: Standard reviewer gate for Phase 4.
- Actor/timing: Reviewer before analyze/tasks/implementation.
